items.html: Know that although we said, regarding the secret of Malchut, that in all thirty-two first paths she was not corrected, this refers to the lower Malchut; but the supernal Malchut, which is in Hochma and Bina, was corrected first. For behold, the eight kings correspond to HGT NHY Malchut, and the eighth king went out together with his mate in the secret of Zeir Anpin and Nukva. Thus Hochma and Bina were corrected, and from Bina downward these eight kings went out.
